notes: 1999 MLB All-Star Game. Pedro Martinez (Red Sox) named MVP, striking out 5 of the 6 batters he faced (including the first four in a row: Barry Larkin, Larry Walker, Sammy Sosa, Mark McGwire).
Scored by D. Gobron. Umpires Reed, Barrett, Miller, Tschida.

Carolina League (A) game: Lynchburg Hillcats (Pittsburgh Pirates affiliate) at Wilmington Blue Rocks (Kansas City Royals affiliate). Score read directly off the scorecard - no official record of this specific game could be found online. D.J. Carrasco and Rob Mackowiak were on that 1999 Lynchburg roster and both went on to multi-year MLB careers; Wilmington's roster included Royals first-round picks Dee Brown and Chris George, who also reached the majors.
